dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Zero-curvature linear trailing edge defined by a single polygonal segment from the apex to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute polygonal vertex with no discernible pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin inclined at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Near-infinite radius due to linear polygonal simplification of the dorsal cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, high-thickness conical projection extending from the anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point of approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon slope and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-green surface luminescence and visible low-polygon mesh topology characteristic of 3D modeling.
